Additional cross-check / limitations:
Saved INTEGRATED_ANALYSIS.json matches the independently recomputed F bracket and C/S/P rate ratios, all five 65-row byte/NMSE/maxabs/NLL comparisons, and top1 changed-row counts. On the 23 selected layers, old first5 training baseline JA H0..6 was [364,867,213,28,0,0,0] (1377 selected slots); current integrated S/P executed-H for every quality/timing block is [362,870,211,29,0,0,0] (1379 slots). This observed aggregate mismatch is evidence that old baseline overlap cannot simply stand in for current integrated execution; no individual hybrid routes were collected, so do not claim which token/expert changed or why. S/P hist equality does not prove identical per-token routes. C histogram is executed H0 by construction.
CSP saved prevision guards: Gpre free=3814981632 B, payload=475453440 B, margin=3221225472 B, strict surplus=118302720 B=112.822265625 MiB; Gpost free=3278110720 B, margin=2684354560 B, surplus=593756160 B=566.25 MiB. They are distinct earlier snapshots and not late-phase/full-context/image peak guarantees. Raw S/P vs F logits differ in rows1..64 even though top1 agrees at all 65 fixed prefixes; this does not prove answer-quality equivalence or meet an unestablished production numerical tolerance. S/P equality proves only these saved outputs under this fixed teacher-forced trajectory. F/C exact and F-before/F-after exact are strong checks for that one trajectory only.
